title.narrative: SEECheck network - fighting disinformation and misinformation through a network of fact-checkers

description.narrative:
OO. To support the resilience of the Southeast Europe information space by strengthening fact-checkers¿ professional networks and independent media to sustainably act against disinformation and misinformation.

SO 1. To enhance CSOs and independent media capacities, knowledge and commitment to provide analysis, monitoring and advocacy on policy, measures and reforms related to media environment and disinformation

SO 2. To strengthen fact-checkers¿ professional networks and independent media capacities for detecting, exposing and acting against dis- and misinformation through networking and cooperation with other CSOs and media outlets at EU, regional, national and local levels

SO 3. To contribute to an enhanced stakeholders¿ support and public/civic participation in fight against disinformation through providing credible information and reaching out to the affected populations

comment.narrative: The 1st Annual Project meeting A2.1 was held in Podgorica on 09 and 10 May 2023 was the initial annual meeting of the SEECheck Network. All of the project partners as well as members of the SEECheck Network were represented at the meeting. It is the first of the three annual Project meetings which are envisaged to be organized during each consecutive year of the project implementation. At the 1st meeting partners discussed and set the plan of activities for the creation of the SEECheck Communication Strategy Data standards and database for fact checks Point 2023 conference and the establishment of the project Steering Committee. The 1st Annual Project meeting was attended by 23 participants eight men and 15 women this way empowering the role of women in the project decision making processes. The second Annual Assembly of the SEECheck Network A2.1 was held in Trpanj Croatia during 2123 September 2023 with all project partners as well as members of the SEE Check Network being represented at the meeting. The Assembly was attended by 37 participants 25 female 67.6 and 12 males 32.4.
